provenance.method: The three Probes (Sensitive, Typical, Cautious) with their calibrated weights, sector-wide BLS, light-curve vetting and the limb-darkened fit, on each star's first SPOC 2-minute sector, as in the benchmark report; every consensus event on the real and control curves, with its light-curve vetting flags (the extended-vetting flags, which never change pass/fail by default, are left out). No FAP rule. Sentinels run on Claude (Anthropic). Probes are deterministic matched-filter detectors.
